name: Wasm4 Gameboy VGM Player
author: Sine System
description: A proof-of-concept music player that emulates the Game Boy sound chip on WASM-4 and plays a chiptune from a VGM file.

descriptions.en: A proof-of-concept music player that emulates the Game Boy sound chip on WASM-4 and plays a chiptune from a VGM file.
descriptions.it: Un lettore musicale sperimentale che emula il chip audio del Game Boy su WASM-4 e riproduce un brano chiptune da un file VGM.
